title: NOT YET PUBLISHED — retrospective comparison of maxgraft vs maxgraft +HyA in socket preservation
supports: The deck presents this as "New Evidence": significantly less vertical shrinkage at 4 months with +HyA (-0.19 ± 0.51 mm vs -0.82 ± 0.95 mm), significantly less volumetric graft shrinkage (10.3 ± 7.7% vs 16.9 ± 11.5%), significantly higher bone density, and less horizontal loss that was NOT statistically significant.
